action:
After a standard system update you need to restart Charybdis to make all
the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that Charybdis incorrectly validated AUTHENTICATE
parameters during SASL authentication. A remote attacker could possibly use
this issue to spoof certificate fingerprints and log in as another user.
isummary: Charybdis could allow unintended access to network services.
title: Charybdis vulnerability
